sn24.16:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave, sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati :
sn24.16:1.4: bhagavammūlakā no bhante, dhammā …pe…. rūpe kho bhikkhave, sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati : “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti. vedanāya sati …pe… saññāya sati …pe… saṅkhāresu sati …pe… viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati : “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti. taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti? …pe… dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya: “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante. vedanā …pe… saññā …pe… saṅkhārā …pe… viññāṇaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tampi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti …pe… dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya : “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti? no hetaṃ bhante. yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa …pe…
